Subject: Intimation of Schedule of Earnings Conference Call under Regulation 30 of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that an Earnings 
Conference Call to discuss the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company 
for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, is scheduled on Wednesday, July 22, 2026 at 11:30 AM IST. 
 
The details pertaining to the said call are enclosed herewith and the same will also be available on the 
Company’s website at https://anthembio.com/ 
 
 
We request you to kindly take the same on record.  
Thanking you, 
Yours truly, 
For Anthem Biosciences Limited 
(Formerly known as Anthem Biosciences Private Limited)
